item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 28/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Winds will be weak over Guangdong today and high temperatures will also trigger showers and thunderstorms. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Saola will linger over the seas east of Luzon today and tomorrow. A weak northeast monsoon will reach southern China tomorrow and there will be more showers over the region. Saola is expected to move in the general direction of the vicinity of Taiwan, and the coast of Fujian and eastern Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of this week, but its movement remains uncertain. Under the combined effect of its outer subsiding air and the northeast monsoon, the weather will be very hot and dry over southern China. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
